name: Plan Luma events by city with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Plan city events with verified Luma details

For community organizers comparing public Luma events by city before choosing events to attend or include in a calendar.

### How it works
1. Collect city events using format, pricing and result filters.
2. Check source coverage and all returned event records before writing to Sheets.
3. Update one row per event and city/filter scope. Use reviewAction with startAt, timezone and registrationAvailability, then open sourceUrl before making plans.

### Setup
- [ ] Select Apify Header Auth on all five HTTP nodes: Authorization with Bearer followed by your token.
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Upsert review register.
- [ ] Create the **Event Planning** tab and import the exact [header CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/luma-events-scraper-monitor/n8n-luma-planning/sheet-header.csv). Set spreadsheetId.
- [ ] In Review settings, start with citySlug=sf. Select eventFormat: all, in_person or online; pricing: all, free or paid. maximumResults supports 1–100 events.

### Reading repeated results
Run manually and sequentially. Existing keys update; unobserved older rows remain, so check observedAt. Empty results add no rows.

The template is free; Apify runs are paid. The $1 cap is a ceiling, not a run price. Repeats may be charged again. [Setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/luma-events-scraper-monitor/n8n-luma-planning/README.md).

## 1. Choose a city and event filters
Set citySlug, eventFormat, pricing and maximumResults in Review settings. Add spreadsheetId and import the Event Planning header before running.

## 2. Collect Luma events once
Run Luma events once starts paid collection. The lower branch waits for that same run; terminal failures stop without writing event rows.

## 3. Verify the event sample
Check OUTPUT coverage, delivered event count and the dataset coverage receipt. COMPLETE covers the declared window; CAPPED stays labelled as a limited sample, not a complete city calendar.

## 4. Build the event planning register
Upsert events by ID and city/filter scope. Read startAt with timezone; reviewAction flags applications, sold-out events and past starts. Check sourceUrl before registering; this workflow does not reserve tickets.
